narr: A small scale thunderstorm system brought a line of heavy rain-producing thunderstorms through Northeastern Pennsylvania. These storms contained torrential rainfall which led to isolated areas of flooding.
ev: Flooding occurred on Hill Street in Jessup. Reports indicated that 2 to 3 feet of water on the road had disabled a vehicle.
